Solve practice problems (PP) throughout the unit as we cover the corresponding topics in class. These problems reinforce the concepts discussed in the lecture notes, handouts, and course resources. Before attempting the homework assignments and preparing for exams, make sure you have completed and reviewed all practice problems from the unit.

You don't need to submit the PP. Once posted, the solutions will be available on Canvas (Files).
